requirements.text: Enhance the user experience of the mobile app to close the gap with leading fintech competitors
Provide real-time notifications for transactions, including transaction amount, merchant name, and updated account balance
Notifications should be delivered within five seconds of transaction authorisation
Offer insights into spending patterns and automated monthly spending breakdowns
Implement biometric authentication methods, including fingerprint and facial recognition
Ensure biometric authentication complies with PSD2's strong customer authentication requirements
Provide a card management feature that allows users to freeze and unfreeze their cards
Ensure the card management functionality is easily accessible from the app's main dashboard
Provide immediate feedback within the app when a card is frozen or unfrozen
Integrate the card management feature with the existing core banking system using current APIs
Implement an in-app lending and credit applications feature with a user-friendly interface
Allow customers to apply for overdraft increases, personal loans, or credit limit changes directly within the app
Provide a brief questionnaire to gather key information for loan applications
Conduct a soft credit check to gauge eligibility for lending without impacting credit scores
Ensure all lending features comply with Central Bank regulations on consumer protection and responsible lending
Ensure compliance with GDPR for data handling in lending applications
